rules.no-std: In Cosmopolitan, no-std implies avoiding standard glibc headers to prevent dynamic linking, using crt.h and runtime.h instead.
rules.alignment: Stack alignment in APE must be 16-byte boundary compliant for SSE/AVX instructions.
rules.binary_size: Binary size can be reduced using -ffunction-sections and -fdata-sections to allow the linker to perform dead code elimination.

compiler_errors.explanation: The linker is looking for a Windows entry point, but Cosmopolitan handles the platform abstraction internally.
compiler_errors.suggestion: Always use standard `int main(int argc, char **argv)` in Cosmopolitan, even when compiling for Windows.

compiler_errors.explanation:
The linker cannot find function `{0}`.
Possible reasons:
• Object not linked
• BUILD.mk missing dependency
• Library not exported
compiler_errors.suggestion: Check if you need to add LIBC_CALLS or the relevant package to _DIRECTDEPS in your BUILD.mk.

compiler_errors.explanation:
Make doesn't know how to build `{0}`.
Possible reasons:
• Missing file
• Typo in _SRCS or _HDRS
• Path is outside hermetic repo
compiler_errors.suggestion: Verify the file path exists and is correctly spelled in your BUILD.mk.

compiler_errors.pattern: fatal error: (.*?): No such file or directory
compiler_errors.explanation:
The compiler cannot find the header `{0}`.
Possible reasons:
• Header not added to _HDRS in its module
• The module providing this header is missing from _DIRECTDEPS
• Typo in the include path
compiler_errors.suggestion: If `{0}` belongs to another Cosmopolitan package, add that package to your BUILD.mk dependencies.

compiler_errors.explanation: A mathematical operation exceeded the capacity of its data type. This results in undefined behavior for signed integers.
compiler_errors.suggestion: Review the arithmetic logic. Test boundary values using: `python guardian.py math add <a> <b> <dtype>`

compiler_errors.explanation: A checked integer arithmetic issue was detected. If using -std=c99, strict ANSI disables GCC built-ins, causing ckd_add to fallback to returning 0.
compiler_errors.suggestion: Compile with -std=gnu99 or -std=c11 to allow __builtin_add_overflow to function correctly.

compiler_errors.explanation: The OS failed to recognize the APE binary format.
compiler_errors.suggestion: On Linux, ensure binfmt_misc is configured via 'ape-install', or verify the file has executable permissions (`chmod +x`).

compiler_errors.explanation: Pledge/Unveil failed at runtime. Cosmopolitan polyfills this on Windows/Mac, but it can be extremely restrictive.
compiler_errors.suggestion: Check that your unveil paths use forward slashes ('/') even on Windows, and ensure you aren't violating Windows-specific strict mode limits.
